home_title: Pontia — Run coding agents locally, control them anywhere
home_description: Open-source remote control for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Kiro, Antigravity, Pi, and ACP agents running on your own devices.
wherever_stage: Demo: move between places while agents work on your devices
wherever_help: Drag the phone, tap a place, or focus the phone and use the arrow keys to move. Press A to approve a request.
wherever_hint: drag me, or tap a place
hero_description: Leave your desk, not your agents. A Bot keeps work moving, with your sessions, files, and local previews always within reach.
hero_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the command to copy it.
hero_demo_caption: Interactive Dashboard demo with sample data. Choose a session or switch devices. Open a Markdown file, explore Git changes and commit history, or follow a localhost link to try the Atlas app.
bots_intro: Hand work to a persistent Bot on your machine. It runs isolated helpers in parallel, queues decisions as todos, and keeps context across days.
bots_pick: Pick a Bot to see how it works.
story_todo_label: Hear from your Bot when it needs you
story_todo_caption: Scope calls turn into todos while your other helpers keep running. Reply when you're ready and the Bot closes each one.
story_todo_ask: Ship the settings page this week.
story_todo_plan: On it. Splitting this across three helpers.
story_todo_question: Should the settings page include API keys, or leave them for later?
story_todo_report: Done. API keys go in a later release. PR #214 is ready when you are.
story_work_label: Step into a native session anytime
story_work_caption: Every helper is a real native CLI Session on your machine. Open it anytime to inspect its steps and steer it directly.
story_work_reply: Three helpers are on it. Open any of them to see what it's doing.
story_work_steer: Use the existing Switch component for the toggles.
story_work_steer_reply: Got it. Switching the toggles over now.
story_local_caption: Open local apps, HTML prototypes, and files right in chat.
story_local_ask: Show me the new sign-in page.
story_local_reply: It’s live on your MacBook. I also built the password reset email.
story_local_brand_title: Plan the quarter in one place.
story_local_brand_description: Roadmaps, docs, and releases for product teams.
story_local_subtitle: Sign in to your Atlas workspace.
story_local_reset_body: Hi Ada, we got a request to reset the password for
story_local_reset_note: This link expires in 30 minutes. If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email.
story_models_label: Use the right model for each task
story_models_caption: Choose a CLI and model for each helper based on its task, from architecture and implementation to research.
story_memory_caption: Store your working preferences in USER.md and project facts in a cross-session memory graph, shared by every Bot on your device.
story_memory_ask: I use pnpm, and I like short replies.
story_memory_fact: Staging builds use a Docker layer cache
story_devices_caption: Control Bots across your workstation, laptop, and build servers in one browser Dashboard over end-to-end encryption, via public or self-hosted Edge.
remote_text: Open the Dashboard in any browser, or add it to your phone's home screen.
remote_lock_drag: Drag the lock to pull the encrypted connection, or hold Space or Enter.
remote_demo_reply_cause: The session cookie expired before the redirect. I fixed the expiry check and want to run the tests.
remote_demo_reply_instead: Sure. Tell me what to run instead.
remote_demo_reply_passed: All tests pass. Should I open a pull request?
remote_demo_reply_shipped: Pull request #128 is open and ready for review.

open_source_title: Every part of Pontia is open source.
open_source_text: The daemon, Dashboard, encryption, relay, and Cloud live in one public repository. See exactly what runs on your device.

account_intro: Manage your profile and the accounts you use to sign in to Pontia.
account_first_device_text: With Node.js and npm installed, run this command on your Linux or macOS device to install and set up Pontia. When prompted, enable remote access and authorize with this account.

sessions_intro: Review and revoke browser sessions and CLI credentials.
sessions_none: No active sessions or CLI credentials.
sessions_sign_out_others_text: This revokes every browser session except the one you are using now. CLI credentials stay active.
devices_intro: Manage devices registered for remote Dashboard access.
devices_edit_text: Update the display name and Dashboard URL handle for this device.
